notes.title: Intro to the Game: How Hero Power Works
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596151/869ed9781a3cc1cb3b3c548129cf1ba04c9a0ea9.png
Hero power is a special effect that triggers automatically every time you play a combo.
It grows stronger with each successful combination — up to a maximum of 5.

1. Combos = progress
Every time you combine two Basic cards into one Final, the hero power meter increases by 1 and activates instantly.
🔹 On the left: Hydra is played as a result of a combo — the power meter grows.

2. Final card — keeps the meter
When you play a Final card directly, the combo meter doesn’t increase, but it also doesn’t reset.
🔸 In the center: Archmage activates the current level of hero power — a smart move to maintain your combo chain.

3. Basic card alone — full reset
If you play a single Basic card without a combo, the entire hero power meter resets to zero.
🔻 On the right: Wind is played on its own — the full combo chain is lost.
📉 This is the least favorable move if you want to maintain your momentum.

💡 Tactics:
Hero power is your reward for consistent play. Keep building combos and avoid breaking the chain — every step counts.

🎯 Your power grows with each combo. Staying sharp is what keeps it.
